questions.question:
REVIEW 11/48 — pair-0daf11f5afd9

REQUEST
Write one Wan text-to-video prompt. A yellow paper boat drifts along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a gray curb; raindrops ripple the water and push tiny leaves past it. The camera makes a slow low tracking move alongside the boat, then gently pulls back as it reaches a storm drain. Photorealistic macro cinematography, cool overcast light. Return one cohesive paragraph only, with no shot list, label, notes, variants, or generation.

OUTPUT A
A yellow paper boat drifts slowly along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a wet gray curb, gently bobbing as raindrops spread overlapping ripples and nudge tiny leaves past its folded hull. In one continuous shot, the camera tracks alongside at water level, then gently pulls back as the boat reaches a storm drain, revealing water streaming between the dark metal bars. Photorealistic macro cinematography, shallow depth of field, detailed paper fibers and wet concrete, cool overcast light and soft reflections.

OUTPUT B
A yellow paper boat drifts along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a gray curb, its folded paper texture sharply visible as raindrops scatter expanding ripples across the water and push tiny leaves past it. The camera tracks slowly alongside the boat at water level, then gently pulls back as it reaches a storm drain, maintaining a smooth, continuous movement. Photorealistic macro cinematography captures delicate water reflections and wet curb textures under cool, diffuse overcast light.

CRITERION C14-ROUTE (hard)
The output follows the existing Wan route as one cohesive cinematic paragraph rather than a shot list or image prompt.
